macros.name: arrowheadsize
macros.doc: \arrowheadsize l:length w:width Set the arrowhead size to be length units long and width units wide.

macros.name: arrowheadtype
macros.doc: Set the arrowhead type to type, where type is one of F, T, W, V, or H. There are two kinds of arrowheads.

macros.name: avec
macros.doc: Draw a line with an arrowhead from the current position to (x y).

macros.name: bsegment
macros.doc: Start a drawing segment. The coordinate system is shifted such that the current position corresponds to the coordinate (0 0).

macros.name: btexdraw
macros.doc: Start a TEXdraw drawing. The drawing is terminated with an \etexdraw command.

macros.name: centertexdraw
macros.doc: The \centertexdraw{...} macro centers the box generated by TEXdraw.

macros.name: clvec
macros.doc: Draw a Bezier curve from the current position to the coordinate (x3 y3) which becomes the new current position. The coordinates (x1 y1) and (x2 y2) serve as control points for the curve.

macros.name: cossin
macros.doc: The macro \cossin returns the real-valued cosine and sine of the direction of the line joining two points.

macros.name: currentpos
macros.doc: The macro \currentpos returns the relative coordinates of the current position.

macros.name: drawbb
macros.doc: Draw a ruled box around the effective size of a drawing produced by TEXdraw commands.

macros.name: drawdim
macros.doc: Set the units to dim. The argument dim can be any valid TeX dimension unit.

macros.name: esegment
macros.doc: End a drawing segment. The current position in effect before the corresponding \bsegment command is restored.

macros.name: etexdraw
macros.doc: End a TEXdraw drawing started with a \btexdraw command.

macros.name: everytexdraw
macros.doc: The \everytexdraw command can be used to define a set of TEXdraw commands that will be executed at the beginning of every TEXdraw drawing.

macros.name: fcir
macros.doc: Draw a filled circle with center at the current position.

macros.name: fellip
macros.doc: Draw a filled ellipse with center at the current position.

macros.name: getpos
macros.doc: Decode coordinate values. The coordinates specified by (x y) are decoded.

macros.name: htext
macros.doc: The first form of this command places the TeX text text horizontally with the text reference point at the coordinate (x y).

macros.name: ifill
macros.doc: Close the current path and paint the interior of the region with gray level level.

macros.name: larc
macros.doc: Draw a counterclockwise arc.

macros.name: lcir
macros.doc: Draw a circle with center at the current position.

macros.name: lellip
macros.doc: Draw an ellipse with center at the current position.

macros.name: lfill
macros.doc: The \lfill command fills the region defined by the closed path and draws a line along the enclosing path.

macros.name: linewd
macros.doc: Set the line width to width units.

macros.name: lpatt
macros.doc: Set lines to have the pattern (pattern). A pattern is a sequence of on/off lengths separated by blanks and enclosed in parentheses.

macros.name: lvec
macros.doc: Draw a line from the current position to coordinate (x y).

macros.name: move
macros.doc: Move to coordinate (x y).

macros.name: PSarc
macros.doc: Draw a counterclockwise arc. The center of the arc is at the given position.

macros.name: PSarcn
macros.doc: Draw a clockwise arc. The center of the arc is at the given position.

macros.name: PSfill
macros.doc: Fill a region defined by a path. Each subpath is closed and the enclosed regions painted with the current gray level.

macros.name: PSlineto
macros.doc: Add a line segment to the current path.

macros.name: PSmoveto
macros.doc: Move to the coordinate specified by (x y).

macros.name: PSnewpath
macros.doc: Establish a new path. The PostScript current point becomes undefined.

macros.name: PSsetlinecap
macros.doc: Set the line cap parameter. The value 0 gives a butt cap; 1 gives a round cap; and 2 gives a projecting square cap.

macros.name: PSsetlinejoin
macros.doc: Set the line join parameter. The value 0 gives a miter join; 1 gives a round join; and 2 gives a bevel join.

macros.name: PSstroke
macros.doc: Stroke a PostScript path. The current path is stroked with the current gray level (set with \setgray) and the current line pattern (set with \lpatt).

macros.name: ravec
macros.doc: Draw a line with an arrowhead from the current position, dx units in the x direction and y units in the y direction.

macros.name: realadd
macros.doc: Add two real quantities, assigning the resultant character string representing the sum to the macro \sum.

macros.name: realdiv
macros.doc: Divide two real quantities, assigning the resultant character string representing the result of value1/value2 to the macro \result.

macros.name: realmult
macros.doc: Multiply two real quantities, assigning the resultant character string representing the product to the macro \prod.

macros.name: relsegscale
macros.doc: Adjust the segment scale factor by multiplying by value.

macros.name: relunitscale
macros.doc: Adjust the unit scale factor by multiplying by value.

macros.name: rlvec
macros.doc: Draw a line from the current position, dx units in the x direction and dy units in the y direction.

macros.name: rmove
macros.doc: Move from the current position, dx units in the x direction and dy units in the y direction.

macros.name: rtext
macros.doc: Text can be placed at an arbitrary angle using the \rtext command.

macros.name: savecurrpos
macros.doc: Save the current position as the absolute position referenced by (*px *py).

macros.name: savepos
macros.doc: Save the coordinate position (x y) as the absolute position referenced by (*px *py).

macros.name: setgray
macros.doc: Set the gray level of lines. Gray levels are real values from 0 (black) through intermediate values (gray) to 1 (white).

macros.name: setsegscale
macros.doc: Set the segment scale factor. The argument scale is a real number which is used to scale coordinate values.

macros.name: setunitscale
macros.doc: Set the unit scaling to scale. The argument scale is a real number which is used to scale coordinate values.

macros.name: textref
macros.doc: Set the text reference point for subsequent text commands.

macros.name: vectlen
macros.doc: Return the length of a vector joining two points.

macros.name: vtext
macros.doc: Text can be placed vertically using the \vtext command.

macros.name: writeps
macros.doc: Write PostScript commands to the intermediate PostScript file.

envs.name: texdraw
envs.doc: Start a TEXdraw drawing. The drawing is terminated with an \end{texdraw} command.
